scope: gavd6 checkout only; no remote HAIC examination; environment files summarized separately; snapshot predates this report and inventory
objective: Preserve real movement while repairing tracking failures: Proposal 01 and notebooks/motion_preservation
method: Static inventory and import/reference analysis, targeted source/protocol/evidence review, and local import verification. Categories are recommendations, not move/delete authorization. Source includes tracked files hidden by ignore rules. Ignored generated files are grouped by bundle. No scientific outputs were regenerated.

current_workflow.rationale: Implements, teaches, launches, or tests the selected preservation-versus-repair study.

current_contract.rationale: Selected P1 proposal, common execution contract, measurement design, or its directly linked figures.

shared_dependency.rationale: Imported by the current study; retain at its current path until any extraction is separately verified.

shared_support.rationale: Shared data acquisition, person identity, environment, artifact maintenance, package compatibility, or validation support.

navigation.rationale: Keep this entry point but update its emphasis/status to the motion-preservation objective.

research_reference.rationale: Reusable data, measurement, model-access, or methodological reference; not a separate training objective.

prior_evidence.rationale: Retain the result, protocol, limitations, figures and provenance as an identifiable historical study bundle.

old_source.rationale: No role in the initial P1 method established; retain executable history and tests, and check imports, entry points, links and frozen fingerprints before physical relocation.

old_design.rationale: Superseded proposal, brainstorming, prompt or tutorial. Reclassify as design history and preserve linked assets before moving.

alternative.rationale: Current portfolio alternative or associated figure, not the selected P1 workstream; retain as a reserve rather than declaring it invalid.

existing_archive.rationale: Already archived; retain provenance and compatibility. No second archive move is useful.

preview.rationale: Generated preview or TeX intermediate; removal is conditional on retaining its source/final artifact and confirming no required inbound link.

local_manifest.rationale: Required current manifest, audited identities or person splits; being ignored by Git does not make it disposable.

local_support_manifest.rationale: Inventory/acquisition record supporting current data lineage or a reduced-observation ablation.

local_evidence.rationale: Historical output bundle; preserve configuration, manifests, predictions, reports and receipts together. Check cited paths and verified backup before moving.

local_scratch.rationale: Looks like a generated build, calibration or smoke artifact. Determine retained representative run and provenance links before pruning; directory name alone is insufficient.

cache.rationale: Ordinary runtime cache or filesystem metadata outside a retained run bundle; regenerate as needed after users/processes stop using it.

private_configuration.rationale: Local configuration: retain privately; content was not interpreted or copied into the report.

unknown.rationale: No sufficiently specific basis for archive or deletion; retain and establish ownership.

static_import_caveat: Conservative module-level closure includes function-local imports and is not proof that all code executes. fi_joint_models is reached through a deferred fi_contracts import; it did not load in the workflow/gavd import check. Public lazy exports and generated/dynamic invocations require a separate compatibility review before relocation.
